about.label: ABOUT US
about.title: National Network, Local Expertise
paragraphs: ZhuoJian (Dalian) Law Firm is a branch of Guangdong ZhuoJian Law Firm. Leveraging the headquarters' national network and professional resources, we have built a high-level localized legal service team.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in the Shenzhen CBD, ZhuoJian Law Firm has established multiple branches domestically and overseas. We continue to advance our international development and have obtained vital qualifications, including Provincial Level 1 Bankruptcy Administrator, Patent Agency, and Trademark Agency.

The Dalian branch adheres to the development philosophy of 'seeking excellence over size.' We emphasize an integrated 'Legal + Financial + Tax' service model to provide clients with professional, diligent, and efficient comprehensive legal services.
